minor.issue: lastRecapAt is written to Mongo by _send_recap() but NOT exposed by the API — the Pydantic model KdsConfig (models.py:112) has no lastRecapAt field, so KdsConfig.from_mongo drops it. The review spec explicitly requires '/api/config then exposes lastRecapAt'. Frontend OpsConfig.RecapConfig already reads cfg.lastRecapAt (line 138) and shows 'Last sent: …' — currently a dead branch. Fix: add `lastRecapAt: Optional[str] = None` to KdsConfig.

rca of the issue: Bug — /api/config missing lastRecapAt. RCA: server.py:_send_recap() writes {'lastRecapAt': now_iso()} to db.config via $set (line 453), but the response goes through KdsConfig(**doc) which whitelists only the declared fields (printerHost, printerPort, printerEnabled, recapEmail, slaMinutes). Because Pydantic v2 with default config ignores unknown keys on model construction, lastRecapAt is silently dropped. Reproduction: PUT /api/config recapEmail=delivered@resend.dev → POST /api/reports/shift-recap/send (returns ok:true, emailId set) → GET /api/config → response has NO lastRecapAt key. Mitigation: add `lastRecapAt: Optional[str] = None` to KdsConfig in /app/backend/models.py:112. Frontend already reads cfg.lastRecapAt in OpsConfig.jsx:138 so no UI change is needed.
